description: Inside objc2 define_class! methods, 'return false' fails to compile because the macro converts the return type to objc2::runtime::Bool
resolution: Use a tail expression instead of early return

content: Platform never imports upward: the panel calls back through fn-pointer Handlers and panel::Key, never crate::app; new UI callbacks must follow this

description: AppKit notifications can arrive mid-call, so borrow_mut on app STATE inside an event sink panics with BorrowMutError
resolution: Sinks use try_borrow_mut and re-post the event via platform::events::post on contention

name: run-work-from-other-threads-on-a41e14
description: Run work from other threads on the main thread with platform::events::on_main(FnOnce) and wait for the reply over an mpsc channel; never touch app STATE off-main

content: A platform fn whose first caller lands in a later step needs cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code, reason)), because a plain expect is unfulfilled under cargo test when its own tests use it; the caller step must delete it

description: Calling makeFirstResponder on the search field on every render changes flick snapshot output and drops the caret
resolution: Only move focus when the panel mode (Search/Title/Form) changes

description: Carbon hotkeys (global-hotkey) never fire for CGEventPost events inside the agent sandbox, so a sandboxed spike can't prove tap-rewritten flags trigger hotkeys
resolution: Verify hotkey behavior outside the sandbox (user-run spike or manual smoke)

description: Two extern C declarations of one symbol with different pointer types (CFRelease *mut vs *const) fail clippy clashing_extern_declarations
UNUserNotificationCenter raises an ObjC exception in an unbundled process (cargo run/tests)
resolution: Gate every call on notify::available() (a .app bundle id); never call it from tests

description: Reading an extern static (e.g. kCFRunLoopCommonModes) counts as an unsafe op; combining it with an FFI call in one unsafe block trips clippy multiple_unsafe_ops_per_block.
resolution: Read each extern static into a local in its own unsafe block before the call (see axwatch::main_loop).

content: A pub item that no test uses needs a plain #[expect(dead_code)], not cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code)): it is dead under cargo test too, so the cfg_attr form leaves a warning in the test build.

description: Inside an objc2 define_class! method returning bool, an early `return false` fails to compile ('expected Bool').
resolution: Write the result as a tail expression (if/else) instead of an early return.

description: capture::run(Target::Screen) calls NSScreen via mtm(), so it panics off the main thread.
resolution: Resolve Screen to Display(n) with display_under_mouse on the main thread before handing the request to a worker.
